content.short: Art, charity and comedy to a world on fire.
content.description:
PCC is striving to create a platform to help our artists bring their ideas to the digital space. We work side by side with these artists to connect with well documented charities and non-profit organizations.

As we continue to grow and prepare these projects for the blockchain, we will show you how we are already doing our part to make a difference in the community. Donations have already been made and are ongoing.

We have also dedicated man-hours to the organizations of the artist's choice. As a collective, we can all play our part in making this world a better place.
